sheets.name: Start
consts: Cartafella Analytics Consultancy & Solutions WLL  ·  Doha, Qatar  ·  FY2026–FY2030  ·  QAR  ·  Version 1.2, 16 November 2026
This workbook ships with illustrative sample entries so the Dashboard shows working results. They are NOT real figures, clients or people. "Client A–L" and "Consultant 01–06" are placeholders.

Sample entries are marked EXAMPLE in the "Data flag" column of the Ledger, Contracts, Budget, Clients and Consultants tables and the Balance Sheet (FY2026 and opening columns), and in the FY2025 comparatives.

Before going live: on each sheet, filter Data flag = EXAMPLE and clear the yellow input cells of those rows (or unprotect the sheet and delete the table rows), then clear the EXAMPLE balance sheet values. The red banner on the Dashboard disappears when no EXAMPLE rows remain.

A single, formula-driven finance database for recruitment, staffing and outsourcing. The accounts team records every transaction once in the Ledger; the Dashboard, KPIs, vertical P&L, five-year summary and receivables ageing all update automatically. Nothing on the report sheets is typed in by hand.
Settings: check the company details, VAT rate (0%), corporate income tax settings and KPI targets.
Masters: replace the example clients and consultants with real ones; add cost centres or categories in the blank yellow rows.
Contracts: register each client contract (ID, client, vertical, dates, value, expected margin).
Budget: enter monthly revenue and direct-cost budgets per vertical, plus company-wide overheads, for each year.
Ledger: enter every invoice, cost and overhead as one row. Pick Type first, then the matching Sub-category. Update Payment status when cash arrives.
Balance Sheet: at each year-end (or month-end) enter cash, balances, loans, equity, provisions and headcount.
Review the Dashboard: choose the year and vertical at the top right. Check the Entry check column in the Ledger shows "OK".
Yellow cells are for data entry and are the only unlocked cells.
Grey cells calculate automatically. They are locked – do not overwrite.
Green: meets the target in Settings, or a favourable variance.
Red: below target, adverse variance or overdue.
Sample data flag – delete before going live.
Click a sheet name to open it.

Year, vertical and period selectors (week / month / quarter / half-year / year): tiles vs prior period and same period last year, period at a glance with budget to date, daily cash for the last 7 days, monthly trend, verticals, OPEX, KPIs, ageing.
Side-by-side P&L by month, quarter, half and full year with budget vs actual and cash; weekly P&L and cash (ISO weeks); checks that quarters and halves add up to the year.
Day-by-day fund flow for a month or date range: opening cash, receipts by source, payments by type, closing cash; weekly cash summary; ties to Cash Flow month-ends.
54 KPIs by year with definitions, formulas and green/amber/red status.
Dated quick entries: monthly or one-off totals of revenue, direct costs, OPEX (rent, salaries, utilities …), depreciation, loan interest and principal. Fast alternative to the detail sheets.
Income, consultant fees, other direct costs and overheads (not purchases, registered staff or loan interest).
Invoices register with ageing, reconciled to Ledger income.
Supplier bills and POs charged to contracts – counted as direct cost.
Employees with salary and Qatar Labour Law accruals (gratuity, leave, air ticket, medical, visa) and provisions.
Month-by-month employee cost accruals feeding the P&L and Balance Sheet.
Loans with EMI (PMT) and amortisation schedule; feeds interest, balances and cash flow.
Monthly and annual cash flow with opening and closing cash.
Read only (other cash items: input table)
Contract register with live actuals and renewal alerts.
Monthly budget by vertical for each year.
Year-end balances, debt service, FY2025 comparatives and operating data.
Annual and monthly P&L for each vertical, with budget comparison.
Five-year P&L with EBITDA, tax estimate and growth.
Open invoices and ageing as at today.
Drop-down lists: verticals, categories, clients, consultants, cost centres.
Company details, VAT and CIT settings, Labour Law defaults, YTD cut-off, KPI targets.
One row per transaction. Amounts are positive and exclude VAT; use a negative amount only for a credit note or reversal.
Type decides the report line: Income (revenue), Direct Cost (cost of delivering a placement, contract or service) or Overhead (running the business).
Vertical is required for Income and Direct Cost. For overheads leave it blank (company-wide) unless the cost belongs to one vertical.
Sub-category lists change with Type. Consultant success fees go under Direct Cost; Interest and finance costs and Depreciation under Overhead (needed for EBITDA).

For invoices, enter the Due date (or leave blank to use the default payment terms in Settings). When paid, set Payment status = Paid and the Paid date. For part-payments use Partially paid and Amount received.
Dates must fall between 1 Jan 2026 and 31 Dec 2030. Every row has a transaction date and a cash (paid / received) date, so reports roll up by day, week, month, quarter, half and year.

Monthly Input or detail sheets – never both: enter each figure ONCE, either as a dated quick entry on Monthly Input or in the detail sheets. Settings › Data source per year (default Both) decides which feed the reports.

Every input row: fill Payment method and Bank account once paid, and Entered by. The red "Incomplete – …" flag in the Entry check column names the missing field. Each input sheet has its own HOW TO ENTER line at the top.

Enter each cost in ONE place only: supplier purchases on Purchases, registered employees (salary and benefits) on Employee Cost (QLL), loan interest via Loans, everything else in the Ledger. Every invoice goes in both the Ledger (as Income) and the Invoices register with the same number.

Tables are pre-sized: Ledger 1,500 rows, Contracts 150, Clients 40, Consultants 20. To add more, unprotect the sheet (Review › Unprotect Sheet – there is no password), click in the table, use Table Design › Resize Table, then protect it again. Reports read whole table columns, so they pick up new rows automatically.
All report sheets are protected without a password only to prevent accidental overwrites of formulas.

Tax: Qatar has no VAT at present, so the VAT rate is 0% (the columns are ready if VAT is introduced). Corporate income tax is estimated at 10% on the share of profit set in Settings – confirm the applicable rate and share with the company auditor.
Ageing uses days past the due date as at today, so the buckets move every day. YTD runs to the last closed month (the month before today unless overridden in Settings).
The workbook uses the Poppins font (brand). If Poppins is not installed, Excel substitutes a standard font and everything still works; install Poppins from Google Fonts for the intended look.
Charts and formulas need desktop Excel 2016 or later (or Microsoft 365). Open in Excel and let it calculate once; values refresh automatically after that.
Version 1.2 · 16 Nov 2026 · Prepared for the Cartafella Analytics accounts and finance team. Confidential – internal use only.

sheets.name: Employee Cost (QLL)
consts: Employee cost – Qatar Labour Law accruals
Salary plus monthly accruals for gratuity, annual leave, air ticket, medical insurance and visa / QID / permit fees, per employee. Rates are DEFAULTS in Settings – confirm with the accountant.
Yellow cells are for data entry; grey cells calculate automatically and are locked. Rows flagged EXAMPLE are sample data – delete before going live.

HOW TO ENTER   1. One row per employee on Cartafella payroll / sponsorship.   2. Outsourced = direct cost of a contract (pick Contract ID); Internal = overhead.   3. Enter basic and allowances; overrides only if different from Settings.   4. On exit: Gratuity paid, Leave salary paid and Settlement date.   5. Fill Entered by. Do not repeat salaries in the Ledger.

How it works: each employee accrues cost every month from Assignment start to Assignment end, up to the current month (see QLL Schedule). Outsourced staff are direct costs of their contract and vertical; Internal staff are overheads (Staff salaries).

Gratuity = basic ÷ 30 × 21 days ÷ 12 per month; annual leave = basic ÷ 30 × 21 days (28 days from 5 years of service) ÷ 12; air ticket = annual fare ÷ 12. These three apply only when the contract is 12 months or longer (Settings).

Medical insurance and visa / QID / work-permit fees accrue for every employee. Employee provisions = opening balance + accrued since 1 Jan 2026 − amounts paid. The Balance Sheet uses its own opening provision plus these accruals and payments.
Do not also enter these salaries and benefits in the Ledger, or they will be counted twice. All rates are DEFAULTS under Labour Law No. 14 of 2004 – confirm with the accountant.

dv.tip: Outsourced = direct cost of the contract. Internal = overhead (staff salaries). Do not also enter these salaries in the Ledger.
